note: The services traced through the track graph by tools/build-track-graph.ts, each in one direction of travel; the reverse is traced too. Station names as in OpenStreetMap.

timetable.note: Each service runs a train every `headway` seconds each way, timed to be at `station` `offset` seconds into each headway. T13 and T14 alternate on the shared trunk, so it has a train every 2.5 minutes each way.

depots.note: The depots the red line uses, for the game's list of places to go: a view of each, as world x, y, z (src/geo.ts), the heading and the pitch (radians, as the game's ?cam=). The game flies there.
